newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices sharply higher with futures.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices sharply higher with futures.

text.p: Arabica prices in the Bremen coffee market rose by $11-13 on the week per 50 kg fob as futures posted new highs.
This came amid news Colombia's January output was sharply down and German roasters were planning price hikes.
Brazils were up $11 at $168 basis origin and cost $162 ex-second hand compared with $157 last week ex-origin.
Offers were scarce but spot and afloat Brazils and Central Americans were being snapped up whenever available.
Buyers were also interested in African and Indian arabicas.
Traders also reported robusta sales for all 1997 dates.
